I have complained multiple times about the hostel WiFi not working, but instead of fixing the issue, the management kept accusing me of using multiple PCs. When I explained that I was only using an external screen connected via a data cable, they wrongly claimed I was consuming the entire hostel’s WiFi for screen mirroring.

When that excuse failed, they blamed my web development work, despite it being part of my IT curriculum and mostly offline. Their final response? "We don’t know, we will talk to our IT team."
